lines.trans: Hello, Khanikeyev! You were worried for nothing.
At the kindergarten everything is fine.
Are you sure? There is no police there?
The teacher, of course, is a bit strange.
But they are all like that there.
So sleep peacefully.
Good. Thank you very much for your help.
You are welcome. I am driving home.
Did she leave? Is everything clear?
Well now, did everything go fine?
She understood nothing.
The operation went excellently!
You are free, Grisha.
Go rest after the dancing.

meanings.note: only when answering or making a phone call
Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('big, large').

examples.text: Аракелян просит время. Сумма очень большая.
examples.trans: Arakelyan is asking for more time. The sum is very large.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: Prefix 'во-' ('into, up') marks inward or upward movement (stem 'лноваться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to worry'.

examples.trans: The teacher, of course, is a bit strange.
The experienced educator played with the children.
All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.note: after a plural noun or pronoun: вы все

examples.text: И знаешь, что самое главное? Всем всё равно.
examples.trans: And you know the main thing? Nobody cares.

meanings.note: ends a conversation or an order: 'Всё, свободен' = that's all, you can go
at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: belonging to children or from childhood

examples.trans: This is an old children's book.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.

examples.text: Так, мы идём к слепым. А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: Right, we're going to the blind people. And you go home and do your homework.

ехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to drive, to ride

meanings.en: to go, to drive, to ride
meanings.note: by car, bus, train, in one direction, now

examples.trans: Vitalik, we're going to the Santa Fe.

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.note: Зря ты так = You shouldn't have
Зря ты так = You shouldn't have

examples.text: Вы зря теряете время. Шпионить для вас я не буду.
examples.trans: You're wasting your time. I'm not going to spy for you.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'много'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

examples.text: Мы даём вам ещё немного времени.
examples.trans: We are giving you a little more time.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

examples.text: Паша, я больше не хочу о ней слышать. Понял?
examples.trans: Pasha, I don't want to hear about her again. Understood?

meanings.note: Core Russian pron meaning 'they' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.
That's what the operation is called.

examples.text: Ты посмотри на этих москвичей, лейтенант. А сами операции проваливают.
examples.trans: Just look at these Moscow types, Lieutenant. And they're the ones who mess up operations.

отдыхать.gloss: to rest, to relax, to vacation

meanings.en: to rest, to take a break

examples.text: Вы отдыхайте, а мы сами поедем.
examples.trans: You rest, and we'll go ourselves.
Everything is great, get some rest!
In the summer we vacation by the sea.

meanings.note: used as an exclamation of approval

examples.trans: I know this town really well!

examples.text: Тут кнопки вызова: скорая, полиция и мы.
examples.trans: Here are the call buttons: ambulance, police, and us.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'мощь'). Common feminine noun meaning 'help' in everyday Russian.
понял? = got it?; понял = got it

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Он за мной после концерта ухаживал.
examples.trans: He courted me after a concert once.

пройти.gloss: to go through, to pass; to come along

meanings.note: about a feeling or pain: потом пройдёт = it'll pass
'Пройдёмте' = let's go, an official's polite order

examples.text: Сейчас через сад и мост — и дома.
examples.trans: Right now through the park and the bridge, and I'm home.
The children are walking in the town park.

examples.text: Да вот иду уже! Сейчас через сад и мост — и дома.
examples.trans: I'm walking already! Right now through the park and the bridge, and I'm home.

meanings.note: свободен! = you're dismissed (a boss to an employee)
свободен! = you're dismissed (a boss to an employee)

examples.trans: That's all, Samson, you can go!

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'пать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to sleep', paired with 'поспать'.

examples.text: Ладно, утром позвоню ей. Поехали спать.
examples.trans: All right, I'll call her in the morning. Let's go to sleep.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'покойно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Его не будет часа два. Вы спокойно всё сделаете.
examples.trans: He'll be gone for about two hours. You'll do everything calmly.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'транный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('strange, odd').
at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

meanings.note: 'что я за мэр такой' = what kind of mayor am I
там такие деньги = there's so much money in it

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: fleeting е drops in oblique forms: танца, танцу

examples.trans: She has been doing dance since childhood.

examples.text: Видела я твой танец. Балерина из тебя никакая!
examples.trans: I saw your dance. You're no ballerina at all!

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Что-то голос какой-то не очень уверенный.
examples.trans: Your voice doesn't sound very confident.
He answered in a calm, confident voice.

examples.text: Что-то голос какой-то не очень уверенный. Что конкретно?
examples.trans: Your voice doesn't sound very confident. What specifically?

уехать.gloss: to leave, to go away (by vehicle)

examples.trans: I'll be gone for an hour.

examples.text: Слушай, я уеду на полтора часа. Ты с Викой посиди, понял?
examples.trans: Listen, I'm going out for an hour and a half. You stay with Vika, got it?
It was very clean in the room.
Did she leave? Is everything clear?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
